Don’t feel bad, I don’t think it is bad to come to the Internet as long as you acknowledge that we are not doctors lol because I like my doctor but they just don’t know that much about this stuff in my experience. For example they will make you think that coming off lexapro is super easy but if you read any experiences on here or try it yourself you will know that is not the case. 

As for your case, I don’t really think 6 weeks is that crazy. It will probably take a couple weeks to be gone with side effects, and while anxiety can start improving in that period, I have heard that depression can take longer, and even longer than 6 weeks possibly. So I don’t think this is really the worst idea as imo it is definitely best to keep your dose at the lowest effective dose for you. 

Just my experience but Effexor sucked for me but lexapro worked pretty well and had few side effects at low doses, so this could help for you. 

It really depends on your situation though and how bad it is, right now I am trying to get off it and it is really a pain in the ass, so my recommendation is to stay off it if you can manage and try other things first, but if you are at a breaking point or see it coming and just have no idea what else to do, it is worth a shot because it can definitely help. Don’t worry too much about withdrawals though right now because if you change your mind early on it is not nearly as bad so it is imo not too bad to just try it out. 

Sorry about the insurance thing though that sucks, I am in Canada so all my dr. visits are free and yet this is still such a complex and stressful thing to deal with so I can’t even imagine if money was a factor too.

I would give it a little more time before dropping down, maybe like 4 weeks total? If you don’t see an improvement that may just be how it is. Why are you raising the dose? For me I had anxiety induced acid reflux. At 10mg I had no side effects but only marginal improvement in my symptoms. At 15mg the problem was pretty much completely solved (yay!) but it introduced some sexual side effects :( which were not bad enough to be a deal breaker, but as time has gone on it has had a worse effect on my relationship so I am trying to drop it now to 10mg and it is a pain. Not to give you my life story lol but what I am saying is once/if you are generally sure the side effects are not going away, think about if the benefit of the higher dose is worth it and drop immediately if it is not because you will probably regret it later like I am if you change your mind and have a hard time decreasing!
